joshua.17.p1.b1.text: Now this was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph’s firstborn son …

joshua.17.p1.b2.text: The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.

joshua.17.p1.b3.text: So Joshua gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers, in keeping with the command of the LORD.

joshua.17.p1.b4.text: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons.

joshua.17.p2.b1.text: Ephraim’s territory was to the south, and Manasseh’s was to the north, having the Sea as its border and adjoining Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.

joshua.17.p2.b2.text: The region of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but Tappuah itself, on the border of Manasseh, belonged to Ephraim.

joshua.17.p2.b3.text: But the descendants of Manasseh were unable to occupy these cities, because the Canaanites were determined to stay in this land.

joshua.17.p2.b4.text: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they put the Canaanites to forced labor; but they failed to drive them out completely.

joshua.17.p3.b1.text: Why have you given us only one portion as an inheritance? We have many people …

joshua.17.p3.b2.text: … go to the forest and clear for yourself an area in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim.

joshua.17.p3.b3.text: The hill country is not enough for us … and all the Canaanites who live in the valley have iron chariots …

joshua.17.p3.b4.text: the hill country will be yours as well. It is a forest; clear it … Although the Canaanites have iron chariots and although they are strong, you can drive them out.
